Albania.papers: Monitor; Tirana Times; Exit News; Biznes Albania; Balkan Insight (regional)
Albania.registry: National Business Center (QKB) – business register, free NIPT search at qkb.gov.al (Albanian/English); beneficial-ownership register; Financial Supervisory Authority (AMF); Tirana Stock Exchange
Albania.notes: [Partly verified] Language: Albanian. QKB search is free without login but reportedly blocks some foreign IPs and has no public API. Certified extract fees unpublished. Biznes Albania not confirmed. Few listed companies; financials mostly via filings.

Algeria.papers: El Watan (Économie); TSA Algérie; Algérie Presse Service (APS)
Algeria.notes: [Partly verified] French/Arabic-language sources. Algeria is NOT an OHADA member (earlier note was wrong); the registry is the national trade register (CNRC). Listed-company disclosure is limited; corroborate with official gazette (BOMOP/JORA) and Reuters/Bloomberg.

Andorra.papers: Diari d'Andorra; Bondia; Andorra Business; Alto.ad (Business)
Andorra.registry: Registre de Societats Mercantils (RSM) via government Seu Electronica; no public name search, login/NIA and document requests; Catalan; Autoritat Financera Andorrana (AFA) for financial entities
Andorra.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Catalan/Spanish. Registry access is a login-based document request, no public search or API; fees unclear. Treat AFA as financial supervisor; exchange not confirmed. Rely on press, BOPA gazette and Reuters/Bloomberg.

Angola.papers: Expansão; Jornal de Angola; Novo Jornal
Angola.registry: Guiché Único da Empresa (GUE); Institute of Registries and Notary (IRN); BNA; CMC
Angola.notes: [Partly verified] Portuguese-language sources. Angola is NOT an OHADA / BEAC / BCEAO country (earlier note was wrong). Use Portuguese-language search terms; corroborate registry data with Diário da República.

Antigua and Barbuda.papers: Antigua Observer; Pointe Xpress; Caribbean Business Report
Antigua and Barbuda.registry: Antigua & Barbuda Intellectual Property and Commerce Office (ABIPCO) company registry (abipco.gov.ag, free limited online name search, English); Financial Services Regulatory Commission (FSRC)
Antigua and Barbuda.notes: [Partly verified] English-language jurisdiction. Free ABIPCO search only shows whether an entity is registered; no directors, shareholders or filing history online. Formal search costs about XCD 40. No public UBO register. Newspapers and exchange not re-verified.

Argentina.papers: El Cronista; Ámbito Financiero; iProfesional; La Nación (Economía)
Argentina.registry: Inspección General de Justicia (IGJ, Buenos Aires City companies); provincial public registries of commerce; Boletín Oficial; CNV (securities regulator); Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos (BYMA)
Argentina.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish. No single national registry: IGJ covers only Buenos Aires City, other provinces keep their own registers. Online IGJ search is limited and filings often need paid or procedural requests. Boletín Oficial notices and CNV filings are the free sources for listed firms.

Armenia.papers: Armenian Business News; Hetq; Arka News Agency
Armenia.registry: State Register of Legal Entities (Agency of the State Register of Legal Entities, Ministry of Justice; e-register.am / e-register.moj.am); State Revenue Committee; Central Bank of Armenia; Armenia Securities Exchange (Nasdaq Armenia)
Armenia.notes: [Partly verified] Free search without login, English interface, but records and extracts are in Armenian. No public API; bulk scraping not authorised; no beneficial-owner fields on search page. Member of EAEU, not OHADA.

Australia.papers: Australian Financial Review; The Australian (Business); Capital Brief; The Guardian Australia (Business); The Conversation (business/economy)
Australia.registry: ASIC company and organisation registers (ACN/ARBN and lodged documents); Australian Business Register / ABN Lookup; ASX company announcements and filings; APRA for regulated financial institutions
Australia.trade: Manufacturers' Monthly; Australian Mining; Infrastructure Magazine; ITnews
Australia.notes: [Partly verified] ASIC is the authoritative company register with a public online search in English; basic details free, extracts and documents paid. ABN Lookup confirms ABN and status only. Use ASX announcements for listed entities; ASIC also regulates securities markets.

Austria.registry: Firmenbuch (Justice Ministry, via JustizOnline); Financial Market Authority (FMA); Wiener Börse
Austria.notes: [Partly verified] German-language. Firmenbuch summary is free without registration; extracts and filed accounts are paid and need mobile-phone signature registration or a Verrechnungsstelle. EU BRIS member. WirtschaftsBlatt dropped as defunct (marked archive in draft).

Azerbaijan.papers: Report.az; Trend News Agency; The Business Year (Azerbaijan)
Azerbaijan.registry: State Register of Commercial Entities (State Tax Service, taxes.gov.az; online search not confirmed, records mainly in Azerbaijani); Central Bank; Baku Stock Exchange
Azerbaijan.notes: [Partly verified] Registry run by State Tax Service; public search form, fees and login could not be confirmed. Records historically Azerbaijani-language, English agency site is partial. Not an OHADA state. Verify with local counsel or paid data providers.

Bahamas.papers: The Nassau Guardian; The Tribune; Eyewitness News Bahamas
Bahamas.registry: Registrar General's Department – Corporate Affairs Registration System (CARS portal), paid search about USD 100 per company; Securities Commission of The Bahamas; Bahamas International Securities Exchange (BISX)
Bahamas.notes: [Partly verified] Language: English. Registry search is paid by card; scraping and commercial redistribution are prohibited and no API exists. IBC and offshore ownership is not public. BISX filings are the main listed-company source.

Bahrain.papers: Gulf Daily News; Daily Tribune (newsofbahrain.com); Bahrain News Agency; Trade Arabia
Bahrain.registry: Sijilat commercial registry (Ministry of Industry & Commerce) with public CR-number/name search, no login, English/Arabic; Central Bank of Bahrain (also capital-markets regulator); Bahrain Bourse
Bahrain.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA; GCC regime. Arabic and English. Sijilat search works without login but fees unverified; bulk extraction prohibited; no public beneficial-ownership register. Detailed financials only for listed firms.

Bangladesh.papers: The Financial Express; The Business Standard; The Daily Star (Business); Dhaka Tribune
Bangladesh.registry: RJSC (Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms, Ministry of Commerce; app.roc.gov.bd); Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission; Dhaka Stock Exchange
Bangladesh.trade: The Textile Today; The Daily Star (industry); Energy & Power; The Financial Express sector coverage
Bangladesh.notes: [Unconfirmed] English and Bengali. RJSC online search not confirmed (portal certificate error on last check); paid extracts have needed an account and Bangladeshi mobile OTP. Bulk scraping reportedly prohibited. Press titles and exchange not re-verified.

Barbados.papers: Barbados Today; Nation News; Caribbean Business Report
Barbados.registry: Corporate Affairs and Intellectual Property Office (CAIPO, Business Barbados); Financial Services Commission; Central Bank of Barbados; Barbados Stock Exchange
Barbados.notes: [Verified] English. CAIPO has a public online database search by name or number (name, number, category, date registered only). Extracts and certified copies are fee-based; no director or shareholder fields and no public beneficial ownership search. Bulk scraping is prohibited.

Belgium.papers: De Tijd; L'Echo; Trends/Trends-Tendances; The Brussels Times (Business)
Belgium.registry: Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE/KBO/BCE, FPS Economy; free Public Search kbopub.economie.fgov.be); National Bank of Belgium Central Balance Sheet Office (annual accounts); FSMA; Euronext Brussels
Belgium.notes: [Partly verified] CBE public search is free in Dutch, French, English; covers identity, activities, addresses, not shareholders. Annual accounts via NBB Central Balance Sheet. UBO register restricted to legitimate interest. EU member, linked to BRIS; languages Dutch/French.

Belize.papers: Amandala; Breaking Belize News; Love FM
Belize.registry: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR, bccar.bz); Online Business Registry System (OBRS, login only); Financial Services Commission; Central Bank of Belize
Belize.notes: [Partly verified] English. Public name search at companysearch.bz; OBRS needs a login; certified copies/extracts are paid (about BZD 30-150). No public IBC search or beneficial-ownership data, and bulk scraping is barred. Securities regulator and exchange unconfirmed.

Benin.papers: La Nation; 24 Heures au Bénin; Financial Afrik
Benin.registry: MonEntreprise platform; Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Benin (CCIB); BCEAO
Benin.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Bhutan.registry: Corporate Regulatory Authority (CRA, cra.gov.bt) under Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment; Royal Monetary Authority; Royal Securities Exchange of Bhutan (RSEBL)
Bhutan.notes: [Partly verified] English widely used. No public online company search found; no director, shareholder or financial data published. Fees unpublished. Expect to request extracts from CRA directly; rely on press and licence notices.

Bolivia.papers: La Razón (Economía); El Deber; Opinión; Página Siete (archive)
Bolivia.registry: SEPREC Registry of Commerce (seprec.gob.bo; created by DS 4596); Electronic Gazette of the Commercial Registry; ASFI; Autoridad de Fiscalización de Empresas
Bolivia.notes: [Partly verified] SEPREC (Servicio Plurinacional de Registro de Comercio) is the commercial registry; public search, fees and login not confirmed. Spanish only. Not an OHADA state. Listed-company data via ASFI and Bolsa Boliviana de Valores.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.papers: Bloomberg Adria (BA edition); N1 Info BA (business); BiznisInfo.ba; Oslobođenje (Business)
Bosnia and Herzegovina.registry: Court business registers per entity (Federation BiH, Republika Srpska, Brčko); Single Registry of Accounts of Business Entities (Central Bank BiH); Securities Commission of FBiH; Republika Srpska Securities Commission; Sarajevo Stock Exchange; Banja Luka Stock Exchange
Bosnia and Herzegovina.notes: [Partly verified] Languages: Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian. Registers are split between entities with no single national search; Brčko is separate. Online access and language vary, and financial statements often come via exchange or agency portals. BiznisInfo and Oslobođenje not confirmed.

Botswana.papers: Business Weekly & Review; Mmegi; The Botswana Gazette
Botswana.registry: Companies and Intellectual Property Authority (CIPA) Online Business Registration System (public search reported unavailable); NBFIRA (non-bank/securities regulator); Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE); Bank of Botswana
Botswana.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. English/Setswana. CIPA online login and search pages reportedly no longer exist; no public API, scraping barred. Private-company financials generally unavailable; use BSE filings and press for listed firms.

Brazil.papers: Valor Econômico; Brazil Journal; Exame; InfoMoney; NeoFeed
Brazil.registry: CNPJ / REDESIM; state Boards of Trade (Juntas Comerciais); CVM; B3 filings
Brazil.trade: MundoLogística; Automotive Business; CanalEnergia; TI Inside
Brazil.notes: [Partly verified] Portuguese. CNPJ lookup is free and gives basic registration data; articles of association and filings sit with state Juntas Comerciais, often paid. Federal country with multiple subnational registries; identify place of incorporation first. Press titles not re-verified.

Brunei.papers: Borneo Bulletin; The Scoop; Biz Brunei
Brunei.registry: Registry of Companies and Business Names (ROCBN, Ministry of Finance and Economy; eRegistry/OCP portal); Brunei Darussalam Central Bank
Brunei.notes: [Partly verified] English and Malay. The Brunei Times closed in 2016 so was removed. Company information is requested through the ROCBN e-registry system, with fee-based extracts; open public search is limited. No OHADA-type regime; coverage of private firms is thin.

Bulgaria.registry: Registry Agency - Commercial Register and Register of Non-Profit Legal Entities (Ministry of Justice; public portal, BULSTAT merged into it); Financial Supervision Commission (FSC); Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE)
Bulgaria.notes: [Partly verified] Commercial Register search is free and public, in Bulgarian (Cyrillic); open-data exports exist. Detailed UBO access needs login with qualified e-signature and legitimate interest. Joint-stock shareholders not public unless listed. EU member; BRIS-linked.

Burkina Faso.registry: Maison de l'Entreprise du Burkina Faso / RCCM; OHADA RCCM; BCEAO; BRVM
Burkina Faso.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Burundi.papers: Iwacu; Burundi Eco; Agence Burundaise de Presse
Burundi.registry: Agence de Développement du Burundi / Guichet Unique; RCCM; Banque de la République du Burundi
Burundi.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. Burundi is NOT an OHADA member (earlier note was wrong); corroborate with official gazette and regional press.

Cabo Verde.papers: Expresso das Ilhas; A Nação; Inforpress
Cabo Verde.registry: Casa do Cidadão / commercial registry; Official Gazette (Boletim Oficial, boe.incv.cv); Banco de Cabo Verde; Bolsa de Valores de Cabo Verde
Cabo Verde.notes: [Unconfirmed] Portuguese-language. Official Gazette (boe.incv.cv) is online and useful for incorporations. Commercial-registry online search and securities regulator not confirmed; newspapers not re-verified. Corroborate with Reuters, Bloomberg.

Cambodia.papers: The Phnom Penh Post; Khmer Times; Kiripost; Cambodia Investment Review
Cambodia.registry: Ministry of Commerce – online business registration platform (businessregistration.moc.gov.kh); Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia (SERC); Cambodia Securities Exchange
Cambodia.notes: [Partly verified] English and Khmer. MoC system now requires CamDigiKey login for company account holders; whether a public company search exists was not confirmed. Annual declarations are filed but financials are rarely public. Verify via MoC or licensed agents.

Cameroon.papers: Investir au Cameroun; Business in Cameroon; EcoMatin
Cameroon.registry: CFCE (Centre de Formalités de Création d'Entreprises); RCCM/OHADA; COBAC; BVMAC
Cameroon.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Canada.papers: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business); Financial Post; Canadian Business; BNN Bloomberg; The Logic
Canada.registry: Corporations Canada (federal corporations); Canada’s Business Registries (participating provincial registries); relevant province/territory registry where incorporated; SEDAR+ (public issuer filings); provincial securities regulators
Canada.trade: Canadian Manufacturing; Canadian Mining Journal; Canadian HR Reporter; IT World Canada
Canada.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA-type regime; English and French. Canada's Business Registries is a combined search of participating registries only; follow through to the source registry. Corporations Canada covers federal corporations only, excluding financial institutions and provincial companies. SEDAR+ covers public issuers only.

Central African Republic.papers: Agence Centrafrique Presse; Le Citoyen; Radio Ndeke Luka
Central African Republic.registry: OHADA RCCM via commercial court/one-stop business formalities; BEAC; CEMAC regulator
Central African Republic.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Chad.registry: OHADA RCCM; National Agency for Investment and Exports (ANIE); BEAC; COSUMAF
Chad.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Chile.papers: Diario Financiero; Pulso (La Tercera); América Economía; Ex-Ante
Chile.registry: Registro de Empresas y Sociedades (registrodeempresasysociedades.cl, free, simplified-regime companies only); Diario Oficial; local Conservadores de Comercio; Comisión para el Mercado Financiero (CMF); Bolsa de Santiago
Chile.notes: [Partly verified] Language: Spanish. RES covers only companies under Law 20.659, so older companies appear in Conservadores de Bienes Raíces/Comercio, some fee-based. CMF site lists supervised and listed entities with filings free.

Colombia.papers: Portafolio; La Republica; Valora Analitik; Forbes Colombia
Colombia.registry: RUES (Registro Unico Empresarial y Social, Confecamaras/Chambers of Commerce) online basic search, certificates paid; Supersociedades financial statements; Superintendencia Financiera (securities regulator); Bolsa de Valores de Colombia
Colombia.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Spanish. RUES gives basic data online; certificates and fees via Chambers. Supersociedades holds financials only for supervised companies; NIT needed for many lookups.

Comoros.papers: Al-Watwan; La Gazette des Comores; ORTC
Comoros.registry: National Investment Promotion Agency / business formalities; OHADA-related commercial registration where applicable; Central Bank of Comoros
Comoros.notes: [Partly verified] French and Arabic-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts.

Congo (Brazzaville).papers: Les Dépêches de Brazzaville; Agence Congolaise d'Information; Financial Afrik
Congo (Brazzaville).registry: OHADA RCCM / Guichet Unique; BEAC; COSUMAF
Congo (Brazzaville).notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Congo, Democratic Republic of (DRC).papers: No consistently established specialist business title identified in this draft; use leading national newspapers/business pages plus Reuters, Bloomberg and FT.
