Congo, Democratic Republic of (DRC).notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts.

Costa Rica.papers: El Financiero; La República; Revista Summa; CRHoy (Economía)
Costa Rica.registry: National Registry (Registro Nacional, rnpdigital.com) – legal entities; SUGEF; SUGEVAL; Bolsa Nacional de Valores
Costa Rica.notes: [Unconfirmed] Spanish. Registro Nacional publishes legal-entity guides and a digital portal, but search terms, fees and login were not confirmed; certificates typically paid. Newspapers and trade press not re-verified.

Côte d'Ivoire.papers: Fraternité Matin; L'Infodrome; Sika Finance; Financial Afrik
Côte d'Ivoire.registry: CEPICI / RCCM; OHADA; BCEAO; BRVM; Autorité des Marchés Financiers de l'UMOA
Côte d'Ivoire.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Croatia.papers: Poslovni dnevnik; Lider; Bloomberg Adria; Jutarnji list (Business)
Croatia.registry: Court Register (Sudski registar, Ministry of Justice); FINA annual financial statements (RGFI registry); HANFA; Zagreb Stock Exchange (ZSE)
Croatia.notes: [Partly verified] Croatian. EU member linked to the BRIS register network. Sudski registar offers a public online search by name or OIB; FINA financial statements are the key source for private firms. Some extracts are fee-based. Interface is mainly Croatian.

Cyprus.papers: StockWatch; Cyprus Mail (Business); Financial Mirror; InBusinessNews
Cyprus.registry: Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (companies.gov.cy); Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission (CySEC); Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE)
Cyprus.notes: [Partly verified] Online company search is paid per entity by card (old figure about EUR 8.54, check current fees) with emailed login; English and Greek. Greek-language local press useful. EU member, BRIS-linked; no OHADA.

Czechia (Czech Republic).registry: Justice Ministry Public Register (Obchodní rejstřík, justice.cz, incl. Sbírka listin); ARES; Trade Licensing Register; Czech National Bank
Czechia (Czech Republic).notes: [Partly verified] Czech-language; the commercial register and filed accounts are public online (e-Justice lists it). ARES aggregates state registers. CNB supervises securities. Fee and English-interface details unconfirmed. CIO Business World not confirmed active, so omitted.

Denmark.papers: Børsen; Finans; Berlingske (Business); Danish Shipping News
Denmark.registry: Central Business Register (CVR, via Virk.dk; Erhvervsstyrelsen); Danish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finanstilsynet); Nasdaq Copenhagen
Denmark.notes: [Partly verified] Danish-language, English partly. CVR displays, accounts and webservices are free; manually processed documents are invoiced (e.g. registration certificate DKK 300). Annual accounts available mainly for limited companies. EU BRIS member. Finans title unconfirmed.

Djibouti.papers: La Nation; ADI (Agence Djiboutienne d'Information); Financial Afrik
Djibouti.registry: Guichet Unique / National Investment Promotion Agency; RCCM; Central Bank of Djibouti
Djibouti.notes: [Unconfirmed] Check local-language sources; private-company financial disclosure and registry access vary. Use Reuters, Bloomberg and FT as cross-border supplements.

Dominica.papers: The Sun; Dominica News Online; The Chronicle
Dominica.registry: Companies and Intellectual Property Office (CIPO) – Companies Registry; Financial Services Unit (IBCs); Eastern Caribbean Securities Regulatory Commission; Eastern Caribbean Securities Exchange
Dominica.notes: [Unconfirmed] Language: English. Part of the ECCU; no OHADA. CIPO search is not free (about EC$5) and online search availability is unconfirmed; no public beneficial-ownership registry or API. Few listed firms; check ECSE.

Dominican Republic.papers: Diario Libre (Economia); Listin Diario (Economia); El Dinero; Acento
Dominican Republic.registry: Registro Mercantil kept by Chambers of Commerce (Ley 3-02); DGII taxpayer (RNC) registry; ONAPI; Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SIMV); Bolsa de Valores de la Republica Dominicana
Dominican Republic.notes: [Unconfirmed] No OHADA. Spanish. Online access details to the Registro Mercantil and to fees could not be confirmed; DGII RNC lookup is the practical entity check. Financials mainly for SIMV-registered issuers.

Ecuador.papers: Primicias; Revista Gestión; El Universo (Economía); Forbes Ecuador
Ecuador.registry: Superintendencia de Compañías, Valores y Seguros (SCVS; supercias.gob.ec portal); SRI RUC; Superintendencia de Bancos
Ecuador.notes: [Unconfirmed] Spanish. SCVS is both company registry supervisor and securities regulator, with a document portal and issuer filings. Search fees and login rules not confirmed. Stock exchanges (Quito, Guayaquil) and press titles not re-verified.

Egypt.papers: Al Mal; Enterprise; Daily News Egypt; Egypt Today (Business)
Egypt.registry: Commercial Registry (Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade); General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA); Egyptian Exchange (EGX)
Egypt.notes: [Partly verified] Arabic primary, English in business media. No confirmed free public company search; extracts are obtained through GAFI or Commercial Registry offices, often in Arabic and via local agents. Listed-company filings are on EGX and FRA sites. No OHADA regime.

El Salvador.papers: El Economista; Diario El Mundo; La Prensa Gráfica (Economía)
El Salvador.registry: Centro Nacional de Registros (CNR) - Registro de Comercio; Superintendencia del Sistema Financiero (SSF, securities regulator); Bolsa de Valores de El Salvador; BCR
El Salvador.notes: [Unconfirmed] Spanish-language. CNR commercial register online services exist but free/paid terms could not be verified; certified documents usually fee-based. SSF and Bolsa publish issuer filings for listed firms. Not OHADA. Original row retained largely.

Equatorial Guinea.papers: Ahora EG; Guinea Ecuatorial Press; Diario Rombe
Equatorial Guinea.registry: Ministry of Commerce / business registry; OHADA RCCM; BEAC; CEMAC regulator
Equatorial Guinea.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish, French and Portuguese-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Eritrea.registry: Ministry of Trade and Industry business licensing (Asmara); Bank of Eritrea; official gazette (no online company register)
Eritrea.notes: [Partly verified] No online company register exists. Registration and licensing are handled in person at the Ministry of Trade and Industry in Asmara; remote access to licensing data is unavailable. Shabait is state media. Corroborate with regional reporting.

Estonia.registry: e-Business Register (Äriregister, RIK); Estonian Financial Supervision and Resolution Authority (Finantsinspektsioon); Nasdaq Tallinn
Estonia.notes: [Partly verified] Estonian, with English interface. Register data free for everyone since 1 October 2022, including open data and API; only some non-profit files carry fees. EU BRIS member. Delovõje Vedomosti status unconfirmed, may be defunct.

Eswatini.papers: Business Eswatini; Eswatini Observer; Times of Eswatini
Eswatini.registry: Companies Registry under Companies Act 2009, run by the Companies and Intellectual Property Authority (CIPA; successor to CIPRO, cipa.org.sz site not resolving); Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA); Central Bank of Eswatini; Eswatini Stock Exchange
Eswatini.notes: [Partly verified] Online public search not confirmed; CIPA website did not resolve when checked, so searches may need a request to CIPA. Fees and login unknown. English is the business language. Not an OHADA state. Few listed companies.

Ethiopia.papers: Addis Fortune; The Reporter; Capital Ethiopia; Addis Standard; Ethiopian Business Review
Ethiopia.registry: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration – e-Trade online trade registration and licensing system (etrade.gov.et); regional trade bureaus; Ethiopian Capital Market Authority; Ethiopian Securities Exchange
Ethiopia.notes: [Unconfirmed] Languages: Amharic/English. e-Trade fields, fees and login rules are unconfirmed and the site has been unreliable. Foreign firms also register with the Ethiopian Investment Commission. Exchange is new, so few listed firms; use bank and filing sources.

Fiji.papers: The Fiji Times; Fiji Sun; Fijivillage
Fiji.registry: Registrar of Companies e-services (ROC Pass sign-in required, English); Fiji Revenue and Customs Service; Reserve Bank of Fiji (capital-markets regulator); South Pacific Stock Exchange (SPX)
Fiji.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. English. Registry searches sit behind account sign-in, fees unpublished, no API, bulk resale prohibited. No public beneficial-ownership register. Listed-company data via SPX announcements.

Finland.registry: Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH) Trade Register / Virre; YTJ business information system (ytj.fi, free search); Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority
Finland.notes: [Partly verified] Finnish and Swedish. YTJ search is free and shows Business ID, status, tax debt, LEI; extracts and financial statements via PRH may be paid; PRH open data available. Press titles and Nasdaq Helsinki not re-verified.

France.papers: Les Échos; La Tribune; BFM Business; L'Usine Nouvelle; Challenges
France.registry: INPI – Registre national des entreprises (RNE); Annuaire des Entreprises (official government company directory); Infogreffe / commercial court registers; BODACC (official legal notices); AMF issuer disclosures; Euronext filings
France.trade: L'Usine Nouvelle; Le Moniteur; Journal de l'Automobile; Usine Digitale
France.notes: [Verified] French. RNE and Annuaire des Entreprises are free, searchable by name or SIREN/SIRET. Infogreffe sells accounts and extracts; BODACC is free. AMF and Euronext cover listed issuers. Some personal data is restricted and many private firms keep accounts confidential.

Gabon.papers: L'Union; Gabon Review; Direct Infos Gabon
Gabon.registry: ANPI-Gabon / Guichet de l'Investissement; OHADA RCCM; BEAC; COSUMAF
Gabon.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. Central Africa: BEAC / CEMAC / COSUMAF.

Gambia.papers: The Point; The Standard; Foroyaa; The Alkamba Times
Gambia.registry: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies (Ministry of Justice, Banjul); Gambia Investment and Export Promotion Agency (GIEPA); Central Bank of The Gambia
Gambia.notes: [Unconfirmed] No confirmed online company-name search; registry is largely in-person at Banjul or via lawyer/agent, fees unpublished. English. Records reported incomplete in places. No functioning securities exchange confirmed; not OHADA. Local press English-language.

Georgia.papers: Forbes Georgia; Business Media Georgia (BMG); The Financial
Georgia.registry: National Agency of Public Registry (NAPR) – Registry of Entrepreneurial and Non-Entrepreneurial Legal Entities; National Bank of Georgia
Georgia.notes: [Partly verified] Georgian/English interface; search is captcha-guarded and no API. Paid extracts about 13-75 GEL (plus English extract fee). Bulk scraping and commercial resale of extracts need NAPR authorization; director data not for marketing. Exchange not confirmed.

Germany.papers: Handelsblatt; WirtschaftsWoche; Börsen-Zeitung; Manager Magazin; Finance Magazin
Germany.registry: Handelsregister (commercial register, state courts); Unternehmensregister (central access to company-register information and filed accounting/company documents); Bundesanzeiger (official publication platform); BaFin company/issuer information; Deutsche Börse disclosures
Germany.notes: [Partly verified] German-language. Unternehmensregister research and court register information are free; deposited annual accounts cost EUR 1.00 plus VAT each, paid via account. Small firms file limited accounts. EU BRIS member. Search legal name plus court and number.

Ghana.papers: Business & Financial Times; Graphic Business; Joy Business
Ghana.registry: Office of the Registrar of Companies (orc.gov.gh); Bank of Ghana; SEC Ghana; Ghana Stock Exchange
Ghana.notes: [Partly verified] English-language. Registrar of Companies (orc.gov.gh) publishes a fee schedule and a Companies Bulletin; online search details and login could not be confirmed. Not an OHADA state. Private-company accounts are hard to obtain.

Greece.registry: General Commercial Registry (GEMI) – free search, English interface; Government Gazette; Hellenic Capital Market Commission; Athens Exchange
Greece.notes: [Partly verified] Language: Greek. EU member, no OHADA. GEMI search and basic data are free with English UI, but filed documents are in Greek and certificates cost EUR 5. API is limited to public bodies and financial institutions.

Grenada.papers: The New Today; NOW Grenada; Caribbean Business Report
Grenada.registry: Companies Registry / Corporate Affairs and Intellectual Property Office (CAIPO), Ministry of Legal Affairs (no working online search); Eastern Caribbean Securities Regulatory Commission (ECSRC); Eastern Caribbean Securities Exchange; ECCB
Grenada.notes: [Unconfirmed] No OHADA; Eastern Caribbean (ECCU) regime. English. Registry site unreachable per guide; no online name or status search, no API. Ask the registry or a local attorney. Listed data via ECSRC/ECSIN. Press coverage thin.

Guatemala.papers: Prensa Libre (Economía); El Periódico (archive); República; Estrategia & Negocios
Guatemala.registry: Registro Mercantil (under Ministry of Economy, MINECO); Superintendencia de Administración Tributaria (SAT); Superintendencia de Bancos; Bolsa de Valores Nacional
Guatemala.notes: [Unconfirmed] Spanish. Registro Mercantil has online consultation but search terms, fees and extract access not confirmed. El Periódico is archive only. Press titles and securities oversight not re-verified.

Guinea.registry: Guichet Unique / RCCM (OHADA); Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea; market regulator where relevant
Guinea.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts.

Guinea-Bissau.papers: ANG (Agência de Notícias da Guiné); O Democrata; regional Financial Afrik
Guinea-Bissau.notes: [Partly verified] Portuguese-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Guyana.papers: Kaieteur News; Guyana Chronicle; Guyana Times; OilNOW
Guyana.registry: Deeds and Commercial Registries Authority (DCRA); Guyana Revenue Authority; Bank of Guyana; Guyana Securities Council
Guyana.notes: [Partly verified] English. Stabroek News printed its last edition on 14 March 2026, so it was removed. DCRA has no confirmed online company search; certified extracts need the Commercial Registry counter in Georgetown or local counsel. No public API.

Haiti.registry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MCI) electronic registry of commerce (registre.mci.gouv.ht); Banque de la Republique d'Haiti (BRH)
Haiti.notes: [Unconfirmed] MCI online registry opened 2012, searchable for name availability but only limited per-file data and possible errors. French/Creole; no active stock exchange confirmed. Not OHADA. Verify through notaries and Le Nouvelliste; coverage thin.

Honduras.papers: El Economista; La Prensa; El Heraldo (Economía); Estrategia & Negocios
Honduras.registry: Registro Mercantil (via Chambers of Commerce, e.g. CCIT/Cortés); SAR taxpayer registry; CNBS (Registro Público del Mercado de Valores); Bolsa Centroamericana de Valores (BCV)
Honduras.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish-only. The old registromercantil.gob.hn site no longer resolves; no confirmed working public online search. Certified extracts have historically needed in-person requests or a local attorney. CNBS publishes securities-market registry files online.

Hungary.papers: Portfolio.hu; Világgazdaság; HVG; BBJ (Budapest Business Journal)
Hungary.registry: Ministry of Justice Company Information Service (e-cegjegyzek.hu, free); OCCSZ certified registry (paid, contract); e-Beszámoló accounts portal (free); Magyar Nemzeti Bank
Hungary.notes: [Partly verified] Hungarian, English toggle on main portal. Free extracts are not legally certified, trail court records, use CAPTCHAs and cap broad searches. Financial statements free at e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu. Beneficial ownership not public. EU BRIS member.

Iceland.registry: Skatturinn (Directorate of Internal Revenue) – Fyrirtækjaskrá company register and Ársreikningaskrá annual accounts register; Central Bank of Iceland (financial supervision, merged with FSA); Nasdaq Iceland
Iceland.notes: [Partly verified] Fyrirtækjaskrá is free to search by kennitala or name; filed annual accounts are available as PDFs (cost unconfirmed). Interface mainly Icelandic. EEA state, not OHADA. Iceland's business language is Icelandic.

India.papers: The Economic Times; Business Standard; Mint; Moneycontrol; Financial Express; Hindu BusinessLine; VCCircle; Entrackr; Inc42
India.registry: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) – Company/LLP Master Data (free search) and paid filings via MCA V3 (Rs 100 per company); Registrar of Companies; BSE and NSE corporate filings; SEBI; Tofler, Zauba Corp, Tracxn (commercial aggregators)
India.trade: ET Manufacturing; Autocar Professional; Construction World; Chemical Engineering World; Express Computer
India.notes: [Partly verified] Language: English/Hindi. MCA master data is free, but financials, shareholding returns and charges are paid per company; no official API or bulk download. Aggregators are secondary: cross-check with MCA and exchange filings. Check standalone and consolidated accounts.

Indonesia.papers: Bisnis Indonesia; Kontan; Investor Daily; Katadata; The Jakarta Post (Business)
Indonesia.registry: AHU Online (Ministry of Law and Human Rights) – company register; OJK; Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX); OSS
Indonesia.trade: Kontan sector pages; Petromindo; InfoKomputer; Bisnis Indonesia sector coverage
Indonesia.notes: [Verified 28 Nov 2026] AHU Online (Ministry of Law) is the legal-entity register and is Bahasa Indonesia only; name search is free, deeds/data downloads are paid. OSS issues the NIB business ID and licensing record; check both. Financial-sector firms: OJK.

Iraq.papers: Iraq Business News; Rudaw Business; Shafaq News; Zawya
Iraq.registry: Companies Registration Directorate, Ministry of Trade (new integrated e-platform 2026; no confirmed public search); Iraq Securities Commission; Iraq Stock Exchange; Central Bank of Iraq
Iraq.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Arabic main; Kurdish in KRG. No confirmed public company search; registration platform is for transaction tracking. Disclosure poor for private firms; use ISX filings, Iraq Business News and local lawyers.

Ireland.papers: The Irish Times (Business); Business Post; Irish Independent (Business); Silicon Republic
Ireland.registry: Companies Registration Office (CRO); Central Bank of Ireland; Euronext Dublin company announcements
Ireland.notes: [Partly verified] English. CRO search by name or number is public and lists filed documents; document copies and reports are paid, with optional account. Press titles and trade press not re-verified.

Israel.registry: Israel Corporations Authority (Companies Registrar, Ministry of Justice); Israel Securities Authority (MAGNA filings); Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE)
Israel.notes: [Verified] Hebrew primary, English in Globes and CTech. The Companies Registrar has a public search by company name or number; a full extract costs about 12 ILS and extracts are mostly Hebrew. Private firms rarely file public financials. MAGNA covers listed companies.

Italy.papers: Il Sole 24 Ore; Milano Finanza; ItaliaOggi; Economy Magazine
Italy.registry: Registro Imprese (Chambers of Commerce, run by InfoCamere; registroimprese.it); CONSOB; Borsa Italiana (Euronext Milan); Bank of Italy; IVASS
Italy.notes: [Partly verified] Basic company data is free; full visure, financial statements and shareholder lists are paid (per-document fees) through Registro Imprese or InfoCamere resellers. Italian-language. EU member, BRIS-linked.

Jamaica.papers: Jamaica Observer (Business); The Gleaner (Business); Caribbean Business Report
Jamaica.registry: Companies Office of Jamaica (COJ); Financial Services Commission; Bank of Jamaica; Jamaica Stock Exchange
Jamaica.notes: [Partly verified] English. COJ has been moving filings and searches online, with a 10-minute online business registration launched Oct 2026; fee and search-access details unconfirmed. Observer and Gleaner business sections are active. Caribbean Business Report not re-verified.

Japan.papers: Nikkei; The Japan Times (Business); Toyo Keizai; Diamond Online; Reuters (cross-border reporting)
Japan.registry: Legal Affairs Bureau – corporate registry (登記情報); National Tax Agency Corporate Number Publication Site; EDINET (FSA statutory securities filings); Tokyo Stock Exchange / JPX timely disclosure (TDnet) and listed-company disclosures
Japan.trade: Nikkei Business; Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun; Japan Chemical Week; Logistics Today
Japan.notes: [Partly verified] Japanese-language, no official English. Online register view JPY 331, certified extract JPY 490-600; NTA Corporate Number site and EDINET free. Register lists directors, not shareholders; few private firms publish accounts. Use corporate number as key.

Jordan.papers: The Jordan Times (Business); Al Ghad; Ammon News; Jordan News
Jordan.registry: Companies Control Department; Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply; Jordan Securities Commission; Amman Stock Exchange
Jordan.notes: [Partly verified] Companies Control Department (Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply) registers companies; online registrations have grown, but public search, fees and login were not confirmed. Arabic main language, English widely used. Not an OHADA state.

Kazakhstan.papers: Kursiv; Forbes Kazakhstan; Kapital.kz; The Astana Times; Inform.kz
Kazakhstan.registry: Bureau of National Statistics – search for legal entity or individual entrepreneur (stat.gov.kz, login required); eGov.kz legal-entity extracts; Agency for Regulation and Development of Financial Market; Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE); AIFC AFSA and Astana International Exchange
Kazakhstan.notes: [Partly verified] Languages: Russian/Kazakh (English partly). Part of the EAEU. Stat.gov.kz register search needs authorization and eGov services often need a local digital signature (EDS). Consider AIFC separately for its entities.

Kenya.papers: Business Daily Africa; The EastAfrican; Nation.Africa (Business); Kenyan Wall Street
Kenya.registry: Business Registration Service (BRS) via eCitizen; paid official search (CR12 about Kshs 600-650); Kenya Revenue Authority; Capital Markets Authority; Nairobi Securities Exchange
Kenya.trade: Construction Kenya; CIO Africa; Africa Mining; Food Business Africa
Kenya.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA; EAC member. English and Swahili. BRS official searches are paid via eCitizen (CR12 about Kshs 600-650, quoted fees conflict). Trade titles unverified. Private-company accounts generally not public.

Kiribati.papers: Kiribati News Agency; Radio Kiribati; Pacific regional sources
Kiribati.registry: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Tourism, Commerce, Industry and Cooperatives (Business and Companies Regulatory Division); Ministry of Finance; Central Pacific regional sources
Kiribati.notes: [Unconfirmed] English. No online company search; inspection is manual, counter fee about AUD 0.50, written request, delays of days to weeks. No API or UBO register. Press titles not verified as currently publishing.

Kuwait.papers: Kuwait Times (Business); Arab Times; Al Rai; Zawya
Kuwait.registry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry commercial register (MOCI); Kuwait Chamber of Commerce; Capital Markets Authority; Boursa Kuwait
Kuwait.notes: [Partly verified] Arabic primary, English in Arab Times and Kuwait Times. No confirmed free public company search; MOCI e-services are largely login or Civil ID gated and extracts are in Arabic. Zawya is a data portal, not a newspaper. Listed-firm filings are on Boursa Kuwait.

Kyrgyzstan.papers: 24.kg; Akchabar; Kabar; The Times of Central Asia
Kyrgyzstan.registry: Ministry of Justice Unified State Register of Legal Entities, Branches and Representative Offices (record.minjust.gov.kg); State Tax Service; National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic; Kyrgyz Stock Exchange
Kyrgyzstan.notes: [Partly verified] Register open to public; names in Kyrgyz and Russian. No financial statements, charters or beneficial owners online; sole traders not included. Online portals reorganised repeatedly, verify URL. Russian is main business language; EAEU member, not OHADA.

Laos.papers: Vientiane Times; The Laotian Times; KPL
Laos.registry: Ministry of Industry and Commerce – Enterprise Registration and Management Department (electronic registration system); Bank of Lao PDR
Laos.notes: [Unconfirmed] Lao-language. An electronic business registration system exists, but a free public company search was not confirmed. Securities regulator and exchange not re-verified. Expect limited filings; use official gazette and Reuters/Bloomberg to corroborate.

Latvia.papers: Dienas Bizness; Baltic News Network; Labs of Latvia
Latvia.registry: Register of Enterprises (Uzņēmumu reģistrs, ur.gov.lv); Latvijas Banka (financial and capital market supervisor); Nasdaq Riga
Latvia.notes: [Partly verified] Latvian, English pages machine-translated. Current data free without login; history, documents and person data free with authentication; official statements and non-public copies paid. Announcements and public file documents free since 2021. EU BRIS member.

Lebanon.papers: L'Orient Today (Business); The Business Year; Executive Magazine; An-Nahar
Lebanon.registry: Commercial Register (Ministry of Justice, cr.justice.gov.lb – public online search by registration number or trade name, no login, Arabic only); Ministry of Finance; Banque du Liban; Capital Markets Authority; Beirut Stock Exchange
Lebanon.notes: [Partly verified] Ministry of Justice Commercial Register has a public search, no login, Arabic only; fees unpublished. Financial statements are rarely public. Not an OHADA state. French and English common in business.

Lesotho.papers: Business Times Lesotho; Lesotho Times; Public Eye
Lesotho.registry: Registrar of Companies / Office of the Registrar General (Ministry of Trade and Industry; online business registration project); Central Bank of Lesotho (capital markets); Maseru Securities Market
Lesotho.notes: [Unconfirmed] Languages: English/Sesotho. No confirmed free public online company search found; expect requests via the registry. Few listed firms. Business Times Lesotho not confirmed as currently publishing.

Liberia.papers: The Liberian Observer; FrontPage Africa; The New Dawn
Liberia.registry: Liberia Business Registry (LBR), Ministry of Commerce and Industry (moci.gov.lr; public search unconfirmed, online platforms launched); Liberia Revenue Authority; Central Bank of Liberia
Liberia.notes: [Unconfirmed] No OHADA; no stock exchange confirmed. English. Online registry search unconfirmed; confirm directly with LBR. Records sparse and often paper-based; rely on press, LRA and concession data. Fees and turnaround unpublished.

Libya.papers: Libya Herald; Libya Business News; The Libya Observer
Libya.registry: Economic and Social Development Board / Ministry of Economy commercial register; Central Bank of Libya; Libyan Stock Market
Libya.notes: [Unconfirmed] Arabic main language, English-language outlets exist. Libyan Stock Market reopened after a long closure (reported). No confirmed online registry search; fragmented institutions. Libya Business News status not confirmed.

Liechtenstein.papers: Liechtensteiner Vaterland; Wirtschaft regional; Liechtensteiner Volksblatt (closed 2023, archive only)
Liechtenstein.registry: Office of Justice – Commercial Register (Handelsregister, Amt für Justiz); Financial Market Authority Liechtenstein (FMA)
Liechtenstein.notes: [Partly verified] German. Volksblatt closed in February 2023, so Vaterland is the main daily. Commercial Register extracts are available online through the national portal; fee and detail of free search are unconfirmed. Many holding and foundation entities disclose little. EEA member, not EU.

Lithuania.papers: Verslo zinios (vz.lt); Lietuvos rytas (Verslas); Delfi (Verslas); LRT English; Baltic News Network
Lithuania.registry: State Enterprise Centre of Registers (Registru centras) - Register of Legal Entities (JAR); Bank of Lithuania (securities supervisor); Nasdaq Vilnius
Lithuania.notes: [Partly verified] Register of Legal Entities searchable online by code or name; certified extracts and documents carry government-set fees. Lithuanian-language; financial statements via Centre of Registers. EU member, BRIS-linked.

Luxembourg.registry: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Trade and Companies Register (RCS); RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations); CSSF
Luxembourg.notes: [Partly verified] RCS search by name or number is free, and viewing filed documents is free with a login; extracts and certified copies are paid. Languages: French, German, English. CSSF is the financial regulator. Newspapers not re-verified.

Madagascar.registry: Economic Development Board of Madagascar / EDBM; RCCM; Central Bank of Madagascar
Madagascar.notes: [Unconfirmed] French and Malagasy. Not an OHADA member. Public online registry search not confirmed; RCCM/EDBM data usually by request. Draft listed AMMC, which is Morocco's regulator (removed); local securities/banking supervisor still to be identified.

Malawi.papers: The Nation; Business News Malawi; Malawi24
Malawi.registry: Registrar General – Companies Registry (registrargeneral.gov.mw; also referenced as Companies, Registrations and Intellectual Property Centre, CRIPC); Malawi Investment and Trade Centre; Reserve Bank of Malawi; Malawi Stock Exchange
Malawi.notes: [Partly verified] Registrar General site covers company incorporation; a public search form is not confirmed and fees are unpublished. English is the business language. Not an OHADA state. Few listed companies on Malawi Stock Exchange.

Malaysia.papers: The Edge Malaysia; The Star (Business); New Straits Times (Business); Bernama
Malaysia.registry: Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM); Bursa Malaysia; Securities Commission Malaysia; Bank Negara Malaysia
Malaysia.trade: The Edge Malaysia sector coverage; The Malaysian Reserve; Malaysian Business; Digital News Asia
Malaysia.notes: [Verified 28 Nov 2026] SSM company and business profiles, shareholders, charges and financial information are supplied through four licensed portals: SSM e-Info, MyData-SSM, SSM Search and SafeData-SSM; most documents are paid. Listed-company filings: Bursa Malaysia.

Maldives.papers: The Edition; PSM News; Mihaaru; Maldives Business Review
Maldives.registry: Ministry of Economic Development – business registration; Maldives Monetary Authority; Capital Market Development Authority (CMDA); Maldives Stock Exchange
Maldives.notes: [Unconfirmed] Languages: Dhivehi/English. Online register access and fees are unconfirmed; CMDA publishes announcements for listed issuers. Few listed firms. Maldives Business Review not confirmed as currently publishing.

Mali.papers: Journal du Mali; Maliweb; Financial Afrik
Mali.registry: Guichet Unique / RCCM (OHADA); BCEAO; BRVM; CREPMF
Mali.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Malta.papers: Times of Malta (Business); MaltaToday; BusinessToday; The Malta Independent
Malta.registry: Malta Business Registry (MBR) online company search by name or number; basic data free, accounts, annual returns and beneficial-owner documents for a fee; Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA); Malta Stock Exchange
Malta.notes: [Verified] No OHADA; EU member. English and Maltese. MBR basic details (officers, address, capital) free; filed accounts and returns paid per document. Many small companies file limited financials. Listed data via MSE.

Marshall Islands.papers: Marshall Islands Journal; RNZ Pacific; Pacific regional sources
Marshall Islands.registry: Registrar of Corporations (RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations, administered by International Registries, Inc.; register-iri.com Entity Search); Marshall Islands Maritime Administrator
Marshall Islands.notes: [Partly verified] English. Entity Search exists at register-iri.com but fields and fees unconfirmed; director and shareholder details are usually held by registered agents, not public. Offshore and maritime-heavy; no public API. Press titles not verified.

Mauritania.registry: Guichet Unique / commercial register (RCCM); Central Bank of Mauritania; Financial Market Authority
Mauritania.notes: [Unconfirmed] French and Arabic. Mauritania is not an OHADA member, so no OHADA RCCM portal applies. Public online company search is not confirmed; local counsel in Nouakchott is the practical route. Financial Afrik is pan-African; coverage of private firms is thin.

Mauritius.papers: Business Magazine; L'Express (Économie); Le Défi Business; Eco Austral
Mauritius.registry: Corporate and Business Registration Department (CBRD, companies.govmu.org); online search free (onlinesearch.mns.global), filings via CBRIS; Financial Services Commission; Stock Exchange of Mauritius
Mauritius.notes: [Partly verified] CBRD online search is advertised as free, English interface, no account needed; extracts and filed documents may cost. No public API; scraping terms unclear. English/French business languages. Not OHADA; many global business companies are opaque.

Mexico.papers: El Economista; Expansión; El Financiero; Forbes México
Mexico.registry: Secretariat of Economy – SIGER / Public Registry of Commerce; SIEM; CNBV; BMV/BIVA
Mexico.trade: Manufactura; T21; Energía a Debate; BNamericas
Mexico.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish. SIGER offers public consultation but registries are held per state/jurisdiction and some searches or certificates are fee-based. Identify place of incorporation. Listed issuers are on BMV/BIVA; CNBV regulates securities. Trade titles not re-verified.

Micronesia.papers: Kaselehlie Press; FSM Information Services; Pacific regional sources
Micronesia.registry: FSM Registrar of Corporations (Department of Justice, roc.doj.gov.fm); FSM Banking Board
Micronesia.notes: [Partly verified] English. No online searchable company register found; fees unpublished. Corporate information likely by request to the Registrar; each of the four states also licenses businesses. No stock exchange confirmed. Corroborate with gazettes and regional media.

Moldova.papers: Mold-street; bani.md; Ziarul Financiar (Moldova); Logos Press
Moldova.registry: Public Services Agency (ASP) – State Register of Legal Entities (free online search 'SE Registru' by IDNO or name with captcha; paid extracts via servicii.gov.md/EVO login); National Bank of Moldova; CNPF
Moldova.notes: [Partly verified] ASP State Register has a free search by IDNO or name (Romanian interface, captcha); official extracts are paid and need login. Romanian is main language, Russian widely used. Not an OHADA state.

Monaco.papers: Monaco Tribune; Monaco Matin; Journal de Monaco
Monaco.registry: Répertoire du Commerce et de l'Industrie (RCI) – extracts consulted or bought online at documents.gouv.mc; Business Development Agency (Direction du Développement Économique); IMSEE statistics; Commission de Contrôle des Activités Financières (CCAF)
Monaco.notes: [Partly verified] Language: French. RCI extracts are fee-based with terms limiting reuse; financial statements are rarely public. Few locally listed firms, so check filings in other jurisdictions. Monaco Matin and Journal de Monaco not directly confirmed.

Mongolia.papers: Mongolian Economy; The UB Post; Montsame
Mongolia.registry: General Authority for State Registration (GASR) legal-entity search at opendata.burtgel.gov.mn (free-access form, reCAPTCHA, Mongolian only); Financial Regulatory Commission; Mongolian Stock Exchange (MSE)
Mongolia.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Mongolian main; English limited. GASR search by register number or name, no director lookup, no documented API. Fees unpublished. English-language coverage thin; use MSE disclosures, Montsame and a translator.

Montenegro.registry: Central Registry of Business Entities (CRPS; portal.crps.me, availability unconfirmed); Central Bank of Montenegro; Capital Market Commission; Montenegro Stock Exchange
Montenegro.notes: [Unconfirmed] Montenegrin (Serbian-family), limited English. CRPS portal did not respond on last check and crps.me shows a domain-for-sale page; tariffs unpublished. Check local registry directly. Press titles not re-verified.

Morocco.papers: L'Économiste; Médias24; La Vie Éco; Le Matin (Économie); Challenge
Morocco.registry: OMPIC – Central Commercial Register / Directinfo; AMMC; Bank Al-Maghrib; Casablanca Stock Exchange
Morocco.notes: [Partly verified] French and Arabic. OMPIC and the Directinfo portal supply register data on a fee basis; free public search is unconfirmed and the OMPIC site sometimes fails to load. Listed-firm documents are on AMMC and the Casablanca Stock Exchange. No OHADA regime.

Mozambique.papers: O Pais; Club of Mozambique; Carta de Mocambique; Noticias
Mozambique.registry: Conservatoria do Registo das Entidades Legais (CREL, Ministry of Justice); APIEX; Banco de Mocambique; Bolsa de Valores de Mocambique (BVM)
Mozambique.notes: [Unconfirmed] Portuguese-language. CREL's public website for filings and publication was legislated under 2022 Commercial Code but no working public search confirmed; Official Gazette (Boletim da Republica) remains key. Not OHADA. Diario Economico removed (Portuguese title).

Namibia.papers: The Namibian (Business); Namibian Sun (Business); Business Express; Economist Namibia
Namibia.registry: Business and Intellectual Property Authority (BIPA); Bank of Namibia; Namibia Financial Institutions Supervisory Authority (NAMFISA); Namibia Stock Exchange (NSX)
Namibia.notes: [Partly verified] English. BIPA's website offers no public company-register search or online extract ordering was found; searches usually go through BIPA, agents or paid data providers. Bulk extraction needs authorization. The Namibian and Namibian Sun business pages are active.

Nauru.papers: Nauru Bulletin; RNZ Pacific; Pacific regional sources
Nauru.registry: Registrar of Corporations (Department of Justice and Border Control, Yaren); Nauru Financial Intelligence Unit (limited public company data)
Nauru.notes: [Partly verified] English. No online company search; information only by formal written request to the Department, fees unpublished, use limited to the stated purpose. No beneficial ownership search or stock exchange found. Corroborate with gazettes and regional media.

Nepal.papers: The Kathmandu Post (Money); The Himalayan Times (Business); New Business Age; Bizmandu
Nepal.registry: Office of Company Registrar (OCR, ocr.gov.np); Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON); Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE); Nepal Rastra Bank
Nepal.notes: [Partly verified] OCR runs online company registration; public search details not confirmed. Nepali main language, English used in business. Not an OHADA state. SEBON and NEPSE cover listed companies.

Netherlands.papers: Het Financieele Dagblad; BNR Nieuwsradio; Quote; MT/Sprout
Netherlands.registry: Kamer van Koophandel (KVK) Handelsregister – free basic search, paid extracts and API; Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM); De Nederlandsche Bank; Euronext Amsterdam
Netherlands.notes: [Partly verified] Language: Dutch. EU member, no OHADA. KVK basic search is free; company profiles, extracts and the API are paid. Annual accounts of small firms are limited. RTL Z removed as no longer a distinct outlet; unconfirmed.

New Zealand.registry: New Zealand Companies Office / Companies Register; Financial Markets Authority; NZX
New Zealand.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. English. Companies Register shows directors, shareholders and addresses; financial statements filed only by larger or issuer entities, with Disclose Register for offers. Listed data via NZX. PPSR searches need login and fee.

Nicaragua.papers: Confidencial; La Prensa; Revista Estrategia & Negocios
Nicaragua.registry: Registro Público Mercantil (registropublico.gob.ni, under Supreme Court); Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI); Superintendencia de Bancos y Otras Instituciones Financieras (SIBOIF); Bolsa de Valores de Nicaragua
Nicaragua.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish. Registro Público site did not respond on last check; fees unpublished; certified extracts reportedly via regional office or local attorney, 5-15 business days. Bulk scraping prohibited. Independent press operates partly from exile.

Niger.registry: Maison de l'Entreprise / RCCM (OHADA); BCEAO; BRVM
Niger.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Nigeria.papers: BusinessDay; Nairametrics; The Guardian (Business); Proshare; ThisDay
Nigeria.registry: Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) public search; Securities and Exchange Commission Nigeria; Nigerian Exchange (NGX); Central Bank of Nigeria
Nigeria.notes: [Partly verified] English. The CAC public search works by name or RC number, with no director or shareholder search. The PSC register is not public; CAC terms restrict scraping. Private-company accounts are rarely available. Not in OHADA. Trade titles are only partly confirmed.

North Macedonia.registry: Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia (Centralen registar, crm.com.mk; Trade Register); Securities and Exchange Commission; Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE); National Bank
North Macedonia.notes: [Unconfirmed] Central Registry holds companies and legal persons under EMBS number; searchable online, terms (free/paid) not confirmed. Documents in Macedonian. Annual accounts via the Central Registry. Not EU member; no OHADA.

Norway.papers: Dagens Næringsliv; Finansavisen; E24; Kapital; Shifter
Norway.registry: Brønnøysund Register Centre (Enhetsregisteret, Foretaksregisteret, Regnskapsregisteret); Finanstilsynet; Oslo Børs
Norway.notes: [Partly verified] Norwegian with English pages. Brønnøysund entity search and open data are public online; annual accounts are filed there. Finanstilsynet is the regulator. Fees for some extracts and accounts not confirmed. Many newspapers are paywalled.

Oman.papers: Oman Observer (Business); Times of Oman; Zawya; Oman Economic Review
Oman.registry: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion – commercial register (Invest Easy / Oman Business Platform, tejarah.gov.om); Financial Services Authority (FSA); Muscat Stock Exchange
Oman.notes: [Partly verified] Arabic and English. Commercial register data is sold online through the ministry system with per-service fees (reported RO 5 per request) or bulk subscription packages. Private-company financials are not public. Listed firms disclose via MSX and FSA.

Pakistan.papers: Business Recorder; Dawn (Business); Profit by Pakistan Today; The News (Business)
Pakistan.registry: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) company search; Pakistan Stock Exchange; State Bank of Pakistan
Pakistan.notes: [Verified 28 Nov 2026] SECP is the company registrar; company search and filings are via SECP eServices / the newer eZfile portal. Listed-company announcements: Pakistan Stock Exchange. English-language business press is strong; Urdu sources add little for B2B.

Palau.papers: Island Times; Marianas Variety; Pacific regional sources
Palau.registry: Financial Institutions Commission (FIC) – Corporate Registry (took over from the Attorney General's office on 20 Jan 2025; online registration for corporations); Registrar of Corporations (Ministry of Finance, earlier listing)
Palau.notes: [Partly verified] No public self-service company search found; requests go via the registry, Foreign Investment Board or local attorney. Fees unpublished. English is the business language. Not an OHADA state. Disclosure on private firms is very limited.

Palestine.registry: Companies Controller (Ministry of National Economy); Palestine Monetary Authority; Palestine Capital Market Authority; Palestine Exchange (PEX)
Palestine.notes: [Unconfirmed] Language: Arabic. West Bank and Gaza have separate administration, so records may be split. Public online company search is unconfirmed. Use PEX filings for listed firms. PEPRI/MAS is a research institute, so removed from newspapers.

Panama.papers: La Prensa (Economia); Capital Financiero; Martes Financiero
Panama.registry: Registro Publico de Panama (online consultation, mostly paid/login; Spanish); Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (supervalores.gob.pa); Bolsa de Valores de Panama; Superintendencia de Bancos
Panama.notes: [Unconfirmed] No OHADA. Spanish. Registro Publico lists corporations and officers online but detailed documents are paid; many offshore-style companies disclose little. Financials mainly for SMV-registered issuers. Duplicate paper name removed.

Papua New Guinea.papers: The National; Post-Courier; Business Advantage PNG; EMTV Business
Papua New Guinea.registry: Investment Promotion Authority (IPA) Online Registry System (ipa.gov.pg; Business Entities Registry searchable free of charge); Bank of Papua New Guinea; PNGX
Papua New Guinea.notes: [Partly verified] English. IPA says entity search is free to the public; detailed searches and documents are paid, account may need ID. No API or public UBO register; bulk scraping restricted. Press titles and PNGX not re-verified.

Paraguay.registry: Dirección General de los Registros Públicos (Poder Judicial); Registro Administrativo de Personas y Estructuras Jurídicas (Abogacía del Tesoro); Banco Central del Paraguay; CNV; Bolsa de Valores y Productos de Asunción
Paraguay.notes: [Partly verified] Spanish. Company records sit with the Public Registries and, since Law 6446, the Abogacía del Tesoro legal-persons registry. Online tracking exists for some filings, but full free public search is unconfirmed. Few private firms publish accounts.

Peru.papers: Gestion; Semana Economica; El Comercio (Economia); La Republica (Economia)
Peru.registry: SUNARP - Superintendencia Nacional de los Registros Publicos (Registro de Personas Juridicas); SUNAT RUC; SMV (securities regulator); SBS; Bolsa de Valores de Lima
Peru.notes: [Partly verified] SUNARP directory search is free, no login, Spanish, but shows only registration status, type and office. Shareholders, powers and capital need paid certificates (e.g. copia literal from about S/ 14). Directory updates monthly. SMV publishes listed issuer filings.

Philippines.papers: BusinessWorld; Philippine Daily Inquirer (Business); Manila Bulletin (Business); BusinessMirror; Philippine Star (Business); Bilyonaryo
Philippines.registry: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) – eSPARC and company search; DTI BNRS (sole proprietors); PSE; Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
Philippines.notes: [Partly verified] English and Filipino. SEC both registers companies and regulates securities. SEC document and company-record requests may be fee-based, and the free company search is limited. DTI covers sole proprietors only. PSE disclosures cover listed firms.

Poland.papers: Puls Biznesu; Rzeczpospolita (Economy); Parkiet; Business Insider Polska
Poland.registry: National Court Register (KRS); CEIDG; Central Register of Beneficial Owners; KNF; Warsaw Stock Exchange
Poland.notes: [Partly verified] Polish-language. KRS and CEIDG excerpts are free online by KRS, NIP, REGON or name. Minority shareholders are not shown; source documents may need court visits. MSiG gazette publishes KRS entries. EU BRIS member. Verify financial-statement repository separately.

Portugal.papers: Jornal de Negócios; ECO; Expresso (Economia); Dinheiro Vivo
Portugal.registry: Registo Comercial (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado; registo.justica.gov.pt) – online permanent certificate (certidão permanente) and Empresa Online; annual accounts (IES); CMVM; Euronext Lisbon
Portugal.notes: [Partly verified] Commercial registry data is obtained via the paid online certidão permanente (access code) on Justice Ministry portals; EU e-Justice portal links to it. Portuguese-language. EU member, not OHADA. Annual accounts via IES filings.

Qatar.papers: The Peninsula (Business); Gulf Times (Business); Qatar Tribune; Zawya
Qatar.registry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry – commercial registry, Qatar Business Map portal and Single Window; Qatar Financial Centre registry; Qatar Financial Markets Authority; Qatar Stock Exchange; Qatar Central Bank
Qatar.notes: [Partly verified] Languages: Arabic/English. Qatar Business Map verifies commercial registrations; some data needs login or Qatar ID. QFC firms sit in a separate registry. Unlisted financials are rarely public.

Romania.papers: Ziarul Financiar; Profit.ro; Economica.net; Business Review
Romania.registry: National Trade Register Office (ONRC) with Recom Online (free basic search, paid subscription for detailed data); Ministry of Finance company accounts; Financial Supervisory Authority (ASF); Bucharest Stock Exchange
Romania.notes: [Verified] No OHADA; EU member. Romanian; applications and documents in Romanian. ONRC site free; Recom basic search free, detailed data and certificates paid. Annual accounts filed with Ministry of Finance. Listed data via BVB.

Rwanda.papers: The New Times; Business Times; KT Press
Rwanda.registry: Office of the Registrar General (ORG, Rwanda Development Board; org.rdb.rw, urs.rdb.rw); Rwanda Revenue Authority; Capital Market Authority; Rwanda Stock Exchange
Rwanda.notes: [Partly verified] English, Kinyarwanda, French. No confirmed public company-search form; RDB portal and beneficial-owner register load as app frames, search fees unpublished. Bulk harvesting not authorised. Press titles not re-verified.

Saint Kitts and Nevis.papers: The St Kitts-Nevis Observer; SKN News; SKNIS (government news)
Saint Kitts and Nevis.registry: Financial Services Regulatory Commission (FSRC, St Kitts Companies Registry; separate Nevis registry); Eastern Caribbean Central Bank; Eastern Caribbean Securities Exchange
Saint Kitts and Nevis.notes: [Partly verified] English. No public online company search confirmed on the FSRC site; extracts go through registered agents or local counsel. Nevis entities are held separately and are not publicly searchable. Eastern Caribbean regime; no OHADA. Little financial disclosure for private firms.

Saint Lucia.papers: The Voice; St Lucia Times; Caribbean Business Report
Saint Lucia.registry: Registry of Companies and Intellectual Property (ROCIP, Ministry of Commerce); Financial Services Regulatory Authority; Eastern Caribbean Central Bank; Eastern Caribbean Securities Exchange (ECSE)
Saint Lucia.notes: [Unconfirmed] Registry portal link reported dead; no confirmed online company search, fees unpublished. English. Eastern Caribbean Securities Regulatory Commission and ECSE cover listed firms. Verify through attorneys or in-person searches; not OHADA.

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.papers: Searchlight; iWitness News; The Vincentian; Reuters/Bloomberg/FT as supplements
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.registry: Commerce and Intellectual Property Office (CIPO, cipo.gov.vc) – company registrar with notices and struck-off lists; Financial Services Authority; Eastern Caribbean Central Bank
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.notes: [Unconfirmed] English. CIPO publishes forms, fees and struck-off notices, but a public online company search was not confirmed; expect requests to the registry or a local agent. Searchlight is active in 2026; other titles not re-verified.

Samoa.papers: Samoa Observer; Samoa Business Network; RNZ Pacific
Samoa.registry: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour – Business Registries (businessregistries.gov.ws); Central Bank of Samoa
Samoa.notes: [Partly verified] English. Public online search covers companies, directors and shareholders and secured transactions; fee status unclear and login needed only to file. Samoa Business Network and any local exchange not confirmed. Private financials rarely public.

San Marino.papers: San Marino RTV; Tribuna Sammarinese; regional Il Sole 24 Ore
San Marino.registry: Ufficio Attività Economiche – Registro delle Società; Central Bank of San Marino
San Marino.notes: [Unconfirmed] Check local-language sources; private-company financial disclosure and registry access vary. Use Reuters, Bloomberg and FT as cross-border supplements.

São Tomé and Príncipe.papers: Tela Non; STP-Press; regional Financial Afrik
São Tomé and Príncipe.registry: Guiché Único para Empresas; Banco Central de São Tomé e Príncipe
São Tomé and Príncipe.notes: [Unconfirmed] Language: Portuguese. No confirmed public online company search. OHADA membership not confirmed in my search. Expect to request documents through the Guiché Único or local counsel; no exchange confirmed.

Saudi Arabia.papers: Argaam; Asharq Business; Al Eqtisadiah; Arab News (Business)
Saudi Arabia.registry: Ministry of Commerce – Saudi Business Center / commercial register; Capital Market Authority; Saudi Exchange; ZATCA
Saudi Arabia.trade: MEED; Construction Week Middle East; Oil & Gas Middle East; Logistics Middle East
Saudi Arabia.notes: [Verified 28 Nov 2026] Ministry of Commerce provides commercial-registration (CR) data enquiry and QR verification; the Wathiq platform is used for CR verification. Under the 2025 Commercial Registry Law, CRs are confirmed annually rather than renewed. Interface is mainly Arabic. Listed-company disclosures via Saudi Exchange / CMA.

Senegal.papers: Le Soleil (Économie); Seneweb; Financial Afrik; Agence Ecofin
Senegal.registry: APIX / Bureau d'Appui à la Création d'Entreprise; RCCM (OHADA); BCEAO; BRVM
Senegal.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Serbia.papers: eKapija; Biznis.rs; Bloomberg Adria; Blic Biznis
Serbia.registry: Serbian Business Registers Agency (APR) public electronic registers, free-access search plus paid data deliveries; Securities Commission; Belgrade Stock Exchange
Serbia.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA; not EU. Serbian (Cyrillic and Latin); some English pages. APR registers are public and online; datasets and extracts carry fees (e.g. RSD 40 per entity). Financial statements are filed with APR. Cyrillic matching can complicate searches.

Seychelles.papers: Seychelles Nation; The People; Seychelles Business Studies
Seychelles.registry: Registrar of Companies (registry.gov.sc Search Business, free, English); Financial Services Authority (administers IBCs and capital markets); Central Bank of Seychelles
Seychelles.notes: [Partly verified] English. Public name search for domestic companies; IBC directors and shareholders historically non-public; IBC data via FSA. Beware lookalike sites such as commercialregister.sc. Press titles not re-verified.

Sierra Leone.papers: Awoko; Sierraloaded; The Calabash; African Business
Sierra Leone.registry: Office of the Administrator and Registrar-General (OARG); Corporate Affairs Commission; Securities and Exchange Commission Sierra Leone; National Revenue Authority; Bank of Sierra Leone; Sierra Leone Stock Exchange (limited)
Sierra Leone.notes: [Unconfirmed] English. OARG offers a business-name search page, but company records (status, directors) are not shown online; extracts come via Freetown counsel. Stock exchange activity is minimal. No OHADA regime. Local press coverage of companies is thin.

Singapore.papers: The Business Times; The Edge Singapore; DealStreetAsia; CNA (Business); The Straits Times (Business)
Singapore.registry: ACRA Bizfile (company/entity search, filings and business information); SGX company announcements and annual reports; MAS Financial Institutions Directory and regulatory disclosures
Singapore.trade: The Edge Singapore; Asian Banking & Finance; Asian Power; Manufacturing Asia
Singapore.notes: [Partly verified] ACRA Bizfile basic entity search is public; business profiles, financial statements and officer data are fee-based per document. English. Use SGX filings for listed companies and MAS directory for regulated financial firms.

Slovakia.papers: Hospodárske noviny; Trend; Denník E; SITA
Slovakia.registry: Business Register of the Slovak Republic (Obchodný register, orsr.sk); Register of Financial Statements (registeruz.sk); National Bank of Slovakia
Slovakia.notes: [Partly verified] Slovak-language; the commercial register and filed financial statements are public online (e-Justice and Transparent Data guides). NBS supervises securities. Fee/extract details and English interface not confirmed. Newspapers not re-verified.

Slovenia.papers: Finance; Delo (Business); Bloomberg Adria; The Slovenia Times
Slovenia.registry: AJPES – Slovenian Business Register (PRS) and annual reports; Securities Market Agency (ATVP); Ljubljana Stock Exchange
Slovenia.notes: [Partly verified] Slovene, with English site. Free AJPES registration is required for the ePRS search; e-signed PDF extracts are free, certified extracts and bulk or web-service use are paid. Annual reports (eJN) access not detailed here. EU BRIS member.

Somalia.papers: The Somali Digest; Hiiraan Online; Somali Guardian; regional Africa Intelligence
Somalia.registry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MOCI) – Licensing and Business Registration Department; one-stop-shop database planned; Central Bank of Somalia; sector regulators
Somalia.notes: [Partly verified] MOCI handles business registration; a federal one-stop registration database is planned and public online search is not confirmed. Somali and English used. Not an OHADA state. No stock exchange; disclosure very limited.

Solomon Islands.papers: Solomon Star; Island Sun; Solomon Times Online; SIBC; RNZ Pacific
Solomon Islands.registry: Company Haus (Registry of Companies, Ministry of Commerce) – Solomon Islands Business Registry online search at solomonbusinessregistry.gov.sb; Central Bank of Solomon Islands
Solomon Islands.notes: [Partly verified] Language: English. Online search covers companies, directors and shareholders; document viewing has published fees. No formal stock exchange confirmed. Financial disclosure for private firms is minimal.

South Africa.papers: Business Day; Financial Mail; Moneyweb; Daily Maverick (Business); Engineering News
South Africa.registry: Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) – company/entity search and filed documents; JSE SENS issuer announcements; JSE issuer directory/listings; FSCA for regulated financial services entities; Prudential Authority / SARB for banks
South Africa.trade: Engineering News; Mining Weekly; Creamer Media; ITWeb
South Africa.notes: [Verified 28 Nov 2026] CIPC company searches now require a login (BizPortal BizProfile / CIPC eServices); free search is limited, so detailed records are fee-based. JSE SENS carries listed-company announcements.

South Korea.papers: Maeil Business Newspaper; The Korea Economic Daily; Pulse; The Korea Herald (Business)
South Korea.registry: Supreme Court Internet Registry Office (IROS, Korean, paid extracts); DART electronic disclosure (FSS, free, English path); Korea Exchange (KRX); Financial Services Commission/FSS; National Tax Service
South Korea.trade: ETNews; The Elec; Korea IT Times
South Korea.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Korean main. DART gives free filings and audit reports for listed and larger audited firms, with growing English disclosure; IROS extracts are paid and Korean-only. Private small-firm financials limited; use Korean-language sources.

South Sudan.papers: Radio Tamazuj; Eye Radio; The City Review; regional sources
South Sudan.registry: Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs – Directorate of Registration of Businesses (Business Registration Services eServices portal, brs.eservices.gov.ss, login required); Bank of South Sudan; sector regulator data limited
South Sudan.notes: [Partly verified] English. Business Registration Services portal requires an eServices login; no confirmed public search. Radio Tamazuj and Eye Radio publish online; record gaps are common. Corroborate with gazettes and regional reporting.

Spain.papers: Expansión; Cinco Días; El Economista; El País (Economía)
Spain.registry: Registro Mercantil (Registro Mercantil Central, free name index; sede.registradores.org for paid extracts and accounts); BORME (free official gazette); CNMV; Banco de España
Spain.notes: [Verified] Spanish. EU member in the BRIS network. BORME is free; Registro Mercantil extracts and filed accounts are paid per document. SABI is a commercial database, not a registry. CNMV covers listed issuers; small firms file accounts late or not at all.

Sri Lanka.papers: Daily FT; Echelon; The Sunday Times (Business); EconomyNext
Sri Lanka.registry: Department of Registrar of Companies (eROC online system); Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka; Colombo Stock Exchange; Central Bank of Sri Lanka
Sri Lanka.notes: [Unconfirmed] eROC supports online registration and name reservation; public company-search terms (free/paid) not confirmed. Registrar website had multi-day outage in 2025. English, Sinhala, Tamil. Colombo Stock Exchange announcements cover listed firms.

Sudan.papers: Sudan Tribune; Radio Dabanga; Sudanow; regional Africa Intelligence
Sudan.registry: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Industry and Trade (Companies Act 2015); Central Bank of Sudan; Khartoum Stock Exchange; Capital Market Authority
Sudan.notes: [Partly verified] No working online company search; historic route was in-person in Khartoum, and the commercial registrar has reportedly returned to Khartoum. Interface Arabic. War disruption limits access. Sudan Tribune is active in 2026.

Suriname.papers: De Ware Tijd; Starnieuws; Suriname Herald
Suriname.registry: Chamber of Commerce and Factories (KKF) – Handelsregister (e-services); Central Bank of Suriname; Suriname Stock Exchange
Suriname.notes: [Partly verified] Dutch. No anonymous public search; extracts are requested through a KKF e-services account (reported SRD 300). No public beneficial ownership register or English interface. Corporate financials rarely public. Not an OHADA country.

Sweden.registry: Bolagsverket – Swedish Companies Registration Office (Näringslivsregistret e-service: some information free, documents such as annual reports fee-based); Finansinspektionen; Nasdaq Stockholm
Sweden.notes: [Partly verified] Bolagsverket's register is searchable by organisation number or name; some information is free and documents are charged. Swedish interface; English guidance exists. EU member, not OHADA. Annual reports are filed there.

Switzerland.papers: Handelszeitung; Finanz und Wirtschaft; L'Agefi; Bilanz; Le Temps (Économie); PME Magazine
Switzerland.registry: Zefix – Central Business Name Index (free); cantonal commercial registers; Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB); FINMA; SIX Swiss Exchange
Switzerland.notes: [Partly verified] Languages: German/French/Italian. Zefix is free and open data; cantonal registers are the legal source. Private-company accounts are generally not public. Not EU or OHADA.

Taiwan.papers: CommonWealth Magazine; Commercial Times; Economic Daily News
Taiwan.registry: Ministry of Economic Affairs Commerce Development Administration company registration portal (findbiz.nat.gov.tw, free public search, English view); MOPS filings; Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE); Financial Supervisory Commission
Taiwan.notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA. Traditional Chinese main; English view of FindBiz exists. Registration data is public; fuller registration views need a business certificate. Private-company financials are limited; listed filings are on MOPS/TWSE.

Tajikistan.registry: Ministry of Justice State Registration Authority (adlia.tj) / legal entity register; Tax Committee (TIN); National Bank of Tajikistan; Central Asian Stock Exchange (Dushanbe)
Tajikistan.notes: [Partly verified] Tajik and Russian; no English interface. adlia.tj reportedly times out and has no working public search; no public UBO register. Use local counsel or commercial databases. Press titles not re-verified.

Tanzania.papers: The Citizen (Business); The EastAfrican; Daily News; The Exchange
Tanzania.registry: Business Registrations and Licensing Agency (BRELA); Capital Markets and Securities Authority; Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange; Bank of Tanzania
Tanzania.notes: [Partly verified] English and Swahili. BRELA runs an online registration system; public company search needs ORS use and may require fees or an account. Private-company financials are rarely public. Listed-firm filings are on DSE and CMSA. No OHADA regime. 'The Exchange' is unconfirmed.

Thailand.papers: Bangkok Post (Business); Krungthep Turakij; The Nation (Business); Kaohoon
Thailand.registry: Department of Business Development (DBD) DataWarehouse+ (datawarehouse.dbd.go.th); Securities and Exchange Commission Thailand; Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET)
Thailand.notes: [Partly verified] DBD DataWarehouse needs no login; shows directors, address, shareholders' nationality and filed financial statements, downloadable as PDF or Excel. Mostly Thai-language, partial English. DBD keeps only certain data. SEC/SET filings cover listed firms.

Timor-Leste.papers: Tatoli; Timor Post; Diligente; regional sources
Timor-Leste.registry: SERVE I.P. – Business Registration and Verification Service (serve.gov.tl); Central Bank of Timor-Leste
Timor-Leste.notes: [Partly verified] English/Portuguese/Tetum. SERVE has no company search form; it publishes free downloadable PDF lists of registered entities (not real-time), and extract fees are unpublished. No beneficial-ownership data. Newspapers not re-verified.

Togo.papers: Togo First; République Togolaise; Financial Afrik
Togo.registry: Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE); RCCM (OHADA); BCEAO; BRVM
Togo.notes: [Partly verified] French-language sources. OHADA member (confirmed on ohada.org, 17 members): company records are held in the RCCM under OHADA uniform acts. West Africa: BCEAO / UEMOA / BRVM.

Tonga.papers: Matangi Tonga; Kaniva Tonga; RNZ Pacific
Tonga.registry: Business Registries Office, Ministry of Commerce, Consumer, Trade, Innovation and Labour (businessregistries.gov.to); National Reserve Bank of Tonga
Tonga.notes: [Partly verified] English. Public online registry search is free (business entity, name and PPSA searches); account only needed to file. Private financial statements are generally not public. No securities exchange confirmed.

Trinidad and Tobago.papers: Trinidad and Tobago Guardian (Business); Business Guardian; Newsday; Caribbean Business Report
Trinidad and Tobago.registry: Companies Registry (Registrar General's Department, Ministry of Legal Affairs) – Companies Registry Online System (CROS, login); Trinidad and Tobago Securities and Exchange Commission (TTSEC); Trinidad and Tobago Stock Exchange (TTSE); Central Bank
Trinidad and Tobago.notes: [Partly verified] Companies Registry Online System (CROS) requires login; fees unconfirmed and the site was unresponsive when checked. Beneficial-owner register is not public. English is the business language. CARICOM member, not OHADA.

Tunisia.papers: IlBoursa; La Presse de Tunisie (Économie); Business News; African Manager; WebManagerCenter
Tunisia.registry: Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) – free search at idaraty.tn; Official Bulletin of RNE; Conseil du Marché Financier (CMF); Bourse de Tunis (BVMT); Central Bank of Tunisia
Tunisia.notes: [Partly verified] Languages: Arabic/French. RNE search is online and being fully digitised during 2026; extracts may need an account or fees. Few listed firms; check CMF and BVMT filings.

Türkiye (Turkey).registry: MERSIS (Ministry of Trade, central registry); Turkish Trade Registry Gazette (ticaretsicil.gov.tr, TOBB, free gazette query); Public Disclosure Platform KAP; Capital Markets Board (SPK); Borsa Istanbul
Türkiye (Turkey).notes: [Partly verified] No OHADA; EU customs union only. Turkish. Trade-name query only shows availability; MERSIS records not freely searchable. Listed firms file on KAP; private financials rarely public. Chamber (TOBB) lookups may be needed.

Turkmenistan.papers: Turkmenistan Today; Business Turkmenistan; regional sources
Turkmenistan.registry: Ministry of Finance and Economy – state registration of legal entities; Central Bank; public online access limited
Turkmenistan.notes: [Unconfirmed] Turkmen and Russian. Nothing confirmed in this pass; original row kept. Public online registry access is believed very limited; expect state-controlled sources and need for local agents.

Tuvalu.papers: Tuvalu Media Department; RNZ Pacific; Pacific regional sources
Tuvalu.registry: Registrar of Companies / Ministry of Finance and Economic Development (Funafuti); National Bank of Tuvalu
Tuvalu.notes: [Unconfirmed] English. No online company search found; written requests to the Registrar in Funafuti are the practical route. No stock exchange. Corroborate with official gazettes and regional reporting; a .tv domain is not evidence of Tuvalu incorporation.

Uganda.papers: The Monitor (Business); The Independent; CEO East Africa; Business Focus
Uganda.registry: Uganda Registration Services Bureau (URSB, search registries page); Capital Markets Authority; Uganda Securities Exchange; Bank of Uganda
Uganda.notes: [Unconfirmed] URSB offers online registration and a 'Search URSB registries' service; search fees and login terms not confirmed. English. Certified copies of filings are paid. Not OHADA; East African Community member. Newspaper names retained unverified.

Ukraine (except Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson.papers: Interfax-Ukraine; Liga.net Business; NV Business; Forbes Ukraine; Kyiv Post
Ukraine (except Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson.registry: Unified State Register of Legal Entities (EDR, Ministry of Justice) – open data restored; Opendatabot and YouControl as commercial aggregators; National Securities and Stock Market Commission; National Bank of Ukraine
Ukraine (except Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson.notes: [Partly verified] Ukrainian. Open EDR datasets are free and weekly, but contact details, addresses and KVED codes are omitted, and defense-sector entities are hidden. Aggregators (Opendatabot, YouControl) give richer, partly paid profiles. Registry access was restricted in wartime.

United Arab Emirates.papers: The National (Business); Gulf News (Business); Arabian Business; MEED; Zawya; AGBI
United Arab Emirates.registry: UAE National Economic Register (NER) and Ministry of Economy services; relevant emirate Department of Economy / licensing authority (e.g., Dubai DET, Abu Dhabi ADDED); ADGM Registration Authority public register; DIFC public register; SCA; ADX and DFM disclosures
United Arab Emirates.trade: MEED; Construction Week Middle East; Oil & Gas Middle East; Logistics Middle East
United Arab Emirates.notes: [Partly verified] Arabic and English. NER is free but confirms licences only; emirate and about 44 free-zone registers differ in fees and disclosure. ADGM and DIFC registers are free and show directors and shareholders. Private firms publish no accounts; beneficial ownership is confidential.

United Kingdom.papers: Financial Times; The Times (Business); The Telegraph (Business); City AM; Sifted; Reuters (cross-border reporting)
United Kingdom.registry: Companies House – Find and update company information (UK limited companies; accounts, officers and filings); FCA National Storage Mechanism (regulated issuer disclosures); London Stock Exchange / RNS announcements; FCA Register for regulated firms
United Kingdom.trade: The Manufacturer; Construction News; Logistics Manager; Computer Weekly
United Kingdom.notes: [Partly verified] Companies House 'Find and update company information' is free, needs no registration, and covers filings, officers and charges. Check FCA National Storage Mechanism and RNS for listed issuers. Partnerships and overseas entities may sit on other registers. English; not OHADA.

United States of America.papers: The Wall Street Journal; Bloomberg; Financial Times; CNBC; Fortune; Forbes; Reuters (cross-border reporting)
United States of America.registry: State Secretary of State / Division of Corporations registries (state of incorporation); SEC EDGAR (public-company filings); FINRA BrokerCheck; state securities regulators; NYSE; Nasdaq
United States of America.trade: IndustryWeek; Manufacturing Dive; Supply Chain Dive; CIO; Construction Dive
United States of America.notes: [Partly verified] Language: English. No single national company register: identify the state of incorporation and search that state's registry (many free, some paid). EDGAR covers only SEC filers. Private-company financials are generally not public.

Uruguay.papers: El Observador (Economia); El Pais (Negocios); Ambito; Busqueda
Uruguay.registry: Direccion General de Registros (Registro Nacional de Comercio / Personas Juridicas, MEC; paid certificates); Auditoria Interna de la Nacion for supervised companies; DGI; Banco Central del Uruguay (securities regulator); Bolsa de Valores de Montevideo
Uruguay.notes: [Unconfirmed] No OHADA; Mercosur member. Spanish. Registry information is mostly via paid certificates and procedures on gub.uy; no confirmed free full public search. Financials mainly for BCU-supervised issuers and AIN filers. Listed data via BVM.

Uzbekistan.registry: Public Services Agency / Unified State Register of Enterprises (State Registration Centre under Ministry of Justice per one guide; my.gov.uz); State Tax Committee; National Agency of Perspective Projects; Tashkent Stock Exchange
Uzbekistan.notes: [Unconfirmed] Uzbek and Russian. Public registry search not confirmed on my.gov.uz; certified output may need an account; fees unpublished. Scraping restricted; personal-data law applies. Verify registry body and press titles locally.

Vanuatu.papers: Vanuatu Daily Post; Vanuatu Business Review; RNZ Pacific
Vanuatu.registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – companies registry; Reserve Bank of Vanuatu
Vanuatu.notes: [Verified] English and French (Bislama also used). VFSC Entity Search is free and needs no login; it shows status, address, incorporation date, related persons and many filed PDFs. Pre-2000s paper files need a visit. Securities exchange activity is minimal. No OHADA regime.

Vatican City.papers: No dedicated business press; use Italian business press and official Vatican/Italian sources
Vatican City.registry: No public company register comparable to commercial jurisdictions; Supervisory and Financial Information Authority (ASIF) supervises financial entities; IOR (Vatican bank) publishes annual reports; use Italian Registro Imprese for Italian entities
Vatican City.notes: [Unconfirmed] Vatican City State has no stock exchange or public commercial register confirmed. Italian-language and Latin official texts. Disclosure comes via ASIF annual reports, IOR reports and Vatican press office. Not OHADA.
